$comment: CIOS MACHINE BINDING DECLARATION — DATA ONLY, AUTHORITY NONE.
Mission IMR-003A (Continuous Implementation Operating System). Delivered by IMR-003A-R1 gap closure.
CIOS-01 Article VIII.2 makes this file the SOLE lawful extension surface (CIOS-L-23).
Adding a member to a non-fixed family is a DATA CHANGE that amends no law and alters no engine.
Changing a cardinality fixed by CIOS-01 Article X.1 (24 engines / 24 stages / 22 identity fields)
is NOT a data change and requires a CEP-009 III.1 change to CIOS-01 itself (NS-4).
This file confers no authority. Every authority named is LOCATED in an instrument existing
independently at baseline b26c5bb. Where this file and a located canonical instrument disagree,
the located instrument governs and this file SHALL be corrected.
No identifier in this file is a corpus identifier; none may be presented to REG-AUTO-001 (NS-3).

$write_scope_comment: CIOS-02 §4.3 single-writer property. Every mutable target has exactly one writer; therefore no lock is required anywhere in the model.
$laws_comment: CIOS-01 Art II. Law text is FIXED by CIOS-01 and is NOT reproduced here; this file binds each law to its located enforcer. A law naming no located enforcer is itself a finding (CIOS-01 Art II).

$engines_comment: CIOS-03. class: BOUND (mechanism wholly located) | COMPOSING (sequences/confines located mechanisms; MUST cite an Art VII.3 row) | ABSENT (recorded gap with named owner). Port convention: engine nn holds inbound CIOS-P-(2n-1), outbound CIOS-P-(2n).
$vii3_comment: CIOS-01 Art VII.3 authorizes exactly nine CIOS contributions. No engine may be COMPOSING without citing one. Row r5 is discharged by a declared function in CIOS-10 §3, not by an engine.
$ports_comment: CIOS-05. Payload is specified by abstract payload CLASS only — never by serialization format, protocol, transport, language or schema language (CIOS-L-22, PR-2). Public surface = 8 ports; the other 40 are INTERNAL and may not be relied upon by any downstream mission.
$edges_comment: CIOS-06 §2. DERIVES edges participate in the cycle test; OBSERVES edges terminate at out-degree-0 sinks and cannot lie on a cycle (CIOS-06 §4.2). Graph is scoped to a SINGLE assimilation pass (CIOS-06 §1.1).
$graph_scope_comment: Graph properties are declared under TWO EXPLICIT SCOPES, because conflating them is a defect.
derives_scoped: the DERIVES edge set alone — this is the graph the cycle test runs over.
Under this scope the three observation engines are ISOLATED (no DERIVES edge of either
direction), so they are simultaneously sources and sinks.
combined_scoped: DERIVES + OBSERVES — this is the whole-system view. Under this scope the
observation engines have in-degree 21 and out-degree 0, so CIOS-E-01 is the sole source.
Both scopes are acyclic. CIOS-INV-05 is discharged under the derives_scoped view (CIOS-06 §4).
$stages_comment: CIOS-07. 24 admission stages. No stage may be skipped, merged, reordered or waived (CIOS-L-06). Stages S-23..S-24 bracket the LOCATED EXECUTION INTERVAL, which contains ZERO CIOS stages by design (CIOS-07 §3).

$gate_coverage_comment: All 14 located constitutional gates bind; none is bypassed (CEP-001 LAW-5).
$identity_comment: CIOS-08. The CIOS Canonical Submission Object. CIOS MINTS NOTHING (CIOS-L-14). AIF-L01 bifurcation: every field is RECORDED or DERIVED, never both.
$queues_comment: CIOS-09. All four are STRICTLY UPSTREAM of the located IEC-001 04 Execution Queue. All unbounded — a capacity or backpressure signal would be a prohibited back-edge into CIOS-PL-A.
$key_vector_comment: CIOS-10 §2. Evaluated left to right; first discriminating element decides. Ranks 1-3 are LOCKED by located-order preservation (CIOS-10 §2.3); rank 8 is LOCKED as the terminator that guarantees totality (CIOS-10 §2.4). Ranks 4-7 are freely extensible by data change.

$wave_comment: CIOS-10 §3. W1..W5 are the LOCATED initial segment, reproduced by reference and NOT altered. CIOS adds only the successor rule and the statement that k is unbounded.

wave_successor_function.successor_rule: next(W_k) = W_{k+1}, admissible for all k in N

$interruption_comment: CIOS-11 §1. All ten classes REJECT by default via CIOS-E-17 (default-deny). The only lawful reach into protected work is CIOS-P-35 to CIOS-E-18.
$override_comment: CIOS-11 §4. CIOS-L-21 names EXACTLY TWO authorities; a third is void. Both are LOCATED — CIOS creates neither. Every override traverses CIOS-P-35 and is adjudicated by CIOS-E-18 (default-deny). An unrecorded override is VOID.
